entities.summary: København (Copenhagen) was a Danish owned, British-built five-masted barque used as a naval training vessel until its disappearance after 22 December 1928. Built for the Danish East Asiatic Company in 1921, it was the world's largest sailing ship at the time, and primarily served for sail training of young cadets.
